description: Density system controlling component sizing across the UI.

figma.library: DB UX DS v3 - Core Foundation

densities.description: Available density modes that affect component sizing and spacing.
densities.note: Set via data-density attribute on a parent container. 'regular' is the default. 'functional' is more compact, 'expressive' is more spacious.

sizing-scale.description: The sizing scale steps available within each density.
